title: Optimal b-Colourings and Fall Colourings in $H$-Free Graphs
summary: In a colouring of a graph, a vertex is b-chromatic if it is adjacent to a vertex of every other colour. We consider four well-studied colouring problems: b-Chromatic Number, Tight b-Chromatic Number, Fall Chromatic Number and Fall Achromatic Number, which fit into a framework based on whether every colour class has (i) at least one b-chromatic vertex, (ii) exactly one b-chromatic vertex, or (iii) all of its vertices being b-chromatic.
